newsitem.title: UK: EDP shares gain after upbeat statement.
newsitem.headline: EDP shares gain after upbeat statement.

text.p: Shares in Electronic Data Processing Plc rose on Monday, after the company posted a drop in profits but said it had received significant orders since November for some of its new products.
At 1000 GMT, the stock was up 17p at 76-1/2p.

EDP reported pre-tax profits of 2.5 million stg for the year to September 30, down 19 percent from 3.1 million in 1995, while sales rose to 14.3 million stg from 12.6 million. Earnings per share fell to 6.64p from 7.53p in 1995.

But Michael Heller, chairman of the software group, said in a statement: "Since 30 September 1996 we have received some significant orders for our Merchant, Charisma, UniVision, WinLink and ViaDuct products and I am confident that 1996/1997 will be another acceptable year."
He added that the company was still interested in using its cash reserves to buy compatible software businesses.
The total dividend was raised to 2.20p per share from 2.15p in 1995.
